snippet.title: Crime Boss: Rockay City - Jupiter Character Pack Trailer
snippet.description:
Our newly released 'Jupiter Character Pack' DLC—out now!

Unlock 'Roidiac Jupiter' and unleash her anabolically fueled rage with her new grenade launcher attachment, brass knuckles, and adrenaline booster!

BONUS! Love Jupiter? Download these free DLC wallpapers and enjoy her calming presence on the regular. You can find them in 'server-announcements' on the official Discord!
